description: Full details for one product: description, specifications and dimensions, options with SKU, price and stock, image and page link.

sku.description: SKU (e.g. AWLS-219006) or an arcticsci.com product link

name: get_product

discontinued.description: True when the product is discontinued

image_url.description: Main product image, null when there is none

quote_only.description: True for a custom made, quote-only product: it has no price and cannot be checked out; use request_quote

specifications.description: Specifications and dimensions, in display order

standard_alternative.description: For a quote-only product, the closest standard product sold today; null otherwise or when none is set

items.description: One orderable option of the product.

availability.description: Stock status: in_stock, backorder (available to order) or out_of_stock

option.description: Option name (e.g. Sterile), null when the product has one option

price.description: Price as shown, e.g. $246.00, or Pricing on request

price_usd.description: Published price per selling unit in USD, null when priced on request

title: Get product details
